field_principles.compounding_delta_ci95: Bootstrap CI95 of the final-minus-initial held-out localization-F1 -- excluding 0 is the decision-grade compounding signal.
field_principles.detector_compounds: BARE bool: the capstone reads this; true iff held-out detection localization-F1 rises with accumulated-corpus size BEYOND the no-learning baseline (delta CI95-excl-0) AND the positive control confirms the curve is not flat-because-saturated.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. A win (the detector COMPOUNDS -- held-out metric rises with data beyond the no-learning baseline) and a CLEAN null (saturated on FoVer, positive control confirms no headroom -> cross-domain is the fresh-headroom direction) are BOTH decision-grade.
field_principles.learning_curve: list of {train_corpus_size, held_out_localization_f1, held_out_auroc, held_out_selective_risk} -- the compounding curve (the exp4364 discipline, on the detector).
field_principles.model_specs: The verifier ensemble + corpus + train/held-out split + no-learning + positive-control baselines + n; required methodology.
field_principles.no_learning_baseline: BARE float: the fixed-threshold / equal-weight detector held-out localization-F1 -- the floor the learning curve must beat.
field_principles.positive_control_passed: BARE bool: true iff the from-scratch full-corpus detector confirms non-trivial headroom over the no-learning floor.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records the detector + corpus + ensemble + TRM-stand-down verified; pre-empts the silent-missing-resource fabrication mode.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition for the split, fitting, and bootstrap.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the corpus split + fitted thresholds/weights + learning curve; lets a third party re-run.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: BARE bool=false -- the detector is a learned/energy signal, oracle-distinct.

methodology_note: CPU-only cached-detector fitting. The primary compounding metric is held-out localization-F1; AUROC and selective-risk are reported on the same fixed held-out split. No TRM or live LLM training is invoked.

preconditions_checked.detail: production FoVer scoring path imports and scores a probe row
not invoked; threshold/fusion fitting against cached candidates only
